questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of San Marino?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the San Marino article.

questions.proof: People in San Marino speak the Italian language.
